summary: Infer the section width from the first all-zero column and split the input into equal-width vertical sections separated by blank columns. Blank rows delimit one or more three-row bands. Read each section's fixed color from the first band and its source occupancy from the final band. Build a three-row output in which section i is painted with its own first-band color wherever section (i+1 mod n) is occupied in the final band. In the demonstrated input grammar, every successive input band already performs that same one-section cyclic shape shift, so the output continues the observed sequence once more.
